description: This file contains unit tests for the SimpleXStreamSerializer class in the org.openmrs.serialization package. It tests serialization and deserialization of objects, handling of proxies and whitelisted classes, and exception cases.

classes.name: SimpleXStreamSerializerTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the serialization and deserialization functionalities of the SimpleXStreamSerializer.

methods.name: serialize_shouldSerializeObject
methods.description: Tests that the serializer correctly serializes a complex object with nested collections.

methods.name: deserialize_shouldDeserializeStringToClassInstance
methods.description: Verifies that a serialized string can be deserialized back into an object with the correct attributes.

methods.name: deserialize_shouldNotDeserializeProxies
methods.description: Checks that attempting to deserialize a dynamic proxy throws a SerializationException.

methods.name: deserialize_shouldIgnoreEntities
methods.description: Ensures that XML containing entities throws a SerializationException during deserialization.

methods.name: serialize_shouldNotSerializeProxies
methods.description: Verifies that proxies cannot be serialized and throw an XStreamException.

methods.name: deserialize_shouldNotDeserializeClassesThatAreNotWhitelisted
methods.description: Tests that deserialization of classes outside the whitelist raises a SerializationException.

methods.name: deserialize_shouldDeserializeWhitelistedPackages
methods.description: Checks that classes from whitelisted packages can be deserialized successfully.

methods.name: deserialize_shouldDeserializeWhitelistedClassesAndPackages
methods.description: Verifies deserialization of multiple whitelisted classes and package hierarchies.

methods.name: deserialize_shouldDeserializeWhitelistedHierarchies
methods.description: Tests that hierarchical whitelisted types are deserialized correctly.
